summary.en-US: Self-cleaning Firefox containers for temporary browsing - transparent, bounded cleanup, fully offline.

version.approval_notes: Ephemeral uses a readable, non-minified TypeScript bundle and has no runtime dependencies. Rebuild with `npm ci && npm run package`; see docs/technical.md. There are no host permissions, content scripts, telemetry, remote code, or outbound extension-page connections. The optional downloads permission erases only download-manager entries filtered by Firefox cookieStoreId and never deletes files. docs/technical.md documents categories that Firefox cannot safely scope to a container. Browser-exit policy runs on the next runtime.onStartup because WebExtensions cannot guarantee asynchronous shutdown cleanup.

release_notes.en-US: Fixes container creation with the default about:newtab start page. Ephemeral now uses Firefox's supported URL-omission path when assigning a native New Tab page to a cookieStoreId. Includes adapter and real-Firefox openTab regression coverage.
